title: Human Airway Smooth Muscle Transcriptome Changes in Response to Asthma Medications
assay_types: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
decision: The parent study has 16 libraries. The airway dexamethasone subset has eight; retain the four cell-line pairs. GEO FPKM is not raw counts. Recover the count representation and its reference from the versioned airway package.

rights.reason: GEO public access does not establish unrestricted redistribution permission. Source-specific review remains open.

scorecard_note: Unreviewed fields remain null. A number would imply sample-level review that has not occurred.
